Next step: a focused 30-minute product showcase where we'll:
- Walk through a tailored demo (30k token context, streaming enabled)
- Show a short perf snapshot (latency & cost tradeoffs)
- Align on pilot success criteria and next steps / MAP

I listed 3 windows below for a 30-minute slot next week — please pick one that works for your team, and let me know who from Avery will attend (product + 1 technical). I can send the calendar invite once you confirm.

Option A: Tue Jun 20, 2028 — 09:00–09:30 PT
Option B: Wed Jun 21, 2028 — 11:00–11:30 PT
Option C: Thu Jun 22, 2028 — 14:00–14:30 PT

Thanks — hoping we can lock this in.
